name: Buy food and an iron bar for Death Plateau

evidence.note: Reserve for unnoted bread and trout, the premade drink and one iron bar.

name: Buy climbing boots from Tenzing

evidence.note: Buy one pair of climbing boots at the hut.

name: Accept Denulth’s assignment

evidence.note: Ask how to recover the guard room combination.

name: Ask Eohric who was on duty

evidence.note: Find out Harold was the guard responsible.

name: Ask Harold about the combination

evidence.note: Speak to Harold upstairs at the inn.

name: Ask Eohric how to get Harold to talk

evidence.note: Learn which drink and game will persuade Harold.

name: Collect the ale from the downstairs inn bar

evidence.note: Take an Asgarnian ale and return upstairs to Harold.

name: Offer Harold the two drinks

evidence.note: Offer the Asgarnian ale and the premade Blurberry Special.

name: Win Harold’s IOU at dice

evidence.note: Use the dialogue and carry 101 coins for the immediate win route. No winnings are credited to the planned cash balance.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Harold hands over the IOU.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Continue playing until Harold is out of coins.

name: Read the combination on the IOU

evidence.note: Read the other side of the IOU to record the combination.

name: Set the five stones in the mechanism

evidence.note: Pick up the stones nearby and place them in the arrangement indicated by the IOU.

name: Ask Saba about another mountain path

evidence.note: Enter the cave, ask the hermit and return to the entrance.

name: Ask Tenzing about the secret path

evidence.note: Tenzing asks for spiked boots, ten bread and ten trout.

name: Ask Dunstan about spiking the boots

evidence.note: Dunstan asks for an iron bar and a certificate for his son.

name: Ask Denulth for the certificate

evidence.note: Denulth gives a certificate to take back to Dunstan.

name: Have Dunstan spike the boots

evidence.note: Give Dunstan the certificate, iron bar and climbing boots.

name: Give Tenzing the boots and food

evidence.note: Hand over the spiked boots and the unnoted food. Receive the map.

name: Walk up the secret trail to check it

evidence.note: Follow Tenzing’s trail until the alternate route is recorded.

name: Deliver the map and combination to Denulth

evidence.note: Receive 3,000 Attack XP, steel claws and access to the mountain route.

name: Accept Denulth’s rescue mission

evidence.note: Start the rescue after Death Plateau.

name: Climb the rocky route to the troll arena

evidence.note: Equip climbing boots and climb the rocks on the secret trail.

name: Fight Dad until he yields

evidence.note: Use the arena gate to safespot him if appropriate. Stop when Dad gives up.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Dad yields and the far gate can be used.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring effective combat gear and enough food for the encounter.

name: Defeat a Troll General for the prison key

evidence.note: Defeat a General in the stronghold rooms.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The prison key has dropped and been picked up.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Use suitable gear, food or a safespot.

name: Get Godric’s key from Twig

evidence.note: Pickpocket Twig at Thieving 30 or defeat him for the key.

name: Unlock Godric’s cell

evidence.note: Open Godric’s cell and finish the rescue dialogue.

name: Get Eadgar’s key from Berry

evidence.note: Pickpocket Berry at Thieving 30 or defeat him for the key.

name: Unlock Eadgar’s cell

evidence.note: Free Eadgar for his later appearance at Trollheim.

name: Report Godric’s rescue to Dunstan

evidence.note: Receive a law talisman and the build 242 reward of 2,000 Agility XP.

name: Buy the sled materials and wax supplies

evidence.note: Reserve for the sled components and coating materials.

name: Ask Ug what is wrong

evidence.note: Find Ug inside the stronghold after the rescue quest.

name: Ask Aga what flower she wants

evidence.note: Ask about trollweiss and speak to Ug again before leaving.

name: Ask Tenzing how to reach the flower

evidence.note: Learn about sledding on Trollweiss Mountain.

name: Have Dunstan make the sled

evidence.note: Hand over the three sled materials.

name: Wax the sled

evidence.note: Use the tin to prepare the coating and apply it to the sled.

name: Cross the ice troll cave to the sled slope

evidence.note: Cross the cave and head to the top of the sled run.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The player reaches the sled slope.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring enough food or protection prayers for the ice trolls.

name: Equip the sled and slide to the flower patch

evidence.note: Follow the sled run down to the rare flower.

name: Pick the trollweiss flower

evidence.note: Pick a flower before returning to Ug.

name: Bring the flower to Ug

evidence.note: Give Ug the flower and agree to challenge Arrg.

name: Challenge and defeat Arrg

evidence.note: Challenge Arrg, win the arena encounter and return to the stronghold floor.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Arrg is defeated.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring suitable combat gear and food or use the arena safespot.

name: Report Arrg’s defeat to Ug

evidence.note: Receive Agility and Strength XP and the gems. Keep the sled for later use.

name: Buy ingredients and tools for Eadgar’s Ruse

evidence.note: Reserve for the food, ranarr potion, logs, bait and pestle and mortar.

name: Ask Sanfew what he needs for the ritual

evidence.note: Start after Druidic Ritual and Troll Stronghold.

name: Ask Burntmeat about goutweed

evidence.note: Learn what the cook wants in exchange for the location.

name: Plan the diversion with Eadgar

evidence.note: Speak to Eadgar in his cave after freeing him from the prison.

name: Speak to Parroty Pete and obtain the quest parrot

evidence.note: Ask both questions about the parrot and use the quest bait on the aviary hatch.

name: Bring the parrot to Eadgar

evidence.note: Eadgar explains how to teach the parrot the dialogue.

name: Hide the parrot in the prison rack

evidence.note: Leave the parrot at the rack while gathering the remaining items.

name: Get a dirty robe from Tegid

evidence.note: Ask Tegid for a robe in south Taverley.

name: Deliver the robe and food to Eadgar

evidence.note: Bring the dirty robe, ten grain, five raw chickens and two logs.

name: Prepare the troll thistle potion

evidence.note: Pick the thistle and dry it on the existing Troll Stronghold fire. Grind it and add it to the unfinished ranarr potion.

name: Give Eadgar the troll potion

evidence.note: Give Eadgar the prepared potion.

name: Retrieve the trained parrot

evidence.note: Return to the prison after the other parts of the plan are ready.

name: Return the trained parrot to Eadgar

evidence.note: Give Eadgar the parrot and take the completed decoy.

name: Deliver the decoy to Burntmeat

evidence.note: Use the decoy to get the information about the storeroom key.

name: Find the storeroom key in the kitchen

evidence.note: Search the drawers near Burntmeat.

name: Get past the guards and take goutweed

evidence.note: Use the storeroom key and evade the guards to reach the goutweed.

planned_outcome.success_condition: A goutweed has been taken and the player has returned from the store.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Watch the guard paths and retry after being sent back.

name: Deliver goutweed to Sanfew

evidence.note: Receive 11,000 Herblore XP and unlock Trollheim Teleport.

name: Collect spare goutweed for later quests

evidence.note: Use the same guard route to collect an extra goutweed.

planned_outcome.success_condition: A spare goutweed is held.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Avoid the guards and retry after being caught.

name: Buy statue restoration supplies

evidence.note: Estimate a reserve for the fixed statue materials and Thurgo’s pie.

name: Buy ores and bars for the company orders

evidence.note: Budget for selected iron ore and bar orders. The reserve assumes the player declines incompatible requests before accepting.

name: Take the boat into Keldagrim for the first time

evidence.note: Speak to the Boatman and watch the arrival scene after the collision.

name: Finish the introduction with Commander Veldaban

evidence.note: Speak to Veldaban at the headquarters. Regular Keldagrim boat and minecart services are now available.

name: Ask Blasidar about the statue restoration

evidence.note: Agree to find clothing, boots and the restored battleaxe.

name: Ask Vermundi about clothes for the statue

evidence.note: Learn about the costume book she needs.

name: Find the costume book in the library

evidence.note: Ask the librarian and climb the bookcase. Keep carried weight low enough for the climb.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The costume book is in hand.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bank heavy gear if the bookcase cannot be climbed.

name: Bring the book and start Vermundi’s machine

evidence.note: Hand over the costume book, load a log and coal, then light the machine.

name: Pay Vermundi for the clothes

evidence.note: Give Vermundi 200 coins and take the completed clothes.

name: Ask Saro where to find the boots

evidence.note: Learn who bought the boots.

name: Talk to Dromund and take the left boot

evidence.note: Wait for Dromund to turn away before taking the accessible boot.

name: Use Telekinetic Grab on the other boot

evidence.note: Cast from outside the window when Dromund is away from the boot.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Both boots have been obtained.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Wait for Dromund to move before trying again.

name: Receive the old battleaxe from Santiri

evidence.note: Ask Santiri about the ceremonial axe.

name: Replace the axe’s three sapphires

evidence.note: Fit the three cut sapphires before seeking an Imcando smith.

name: Ask about the Imcando dwarves

evidence.note: Ask the librarian where to find an Imcando smith.

name: Ask Reldo where to find Thurgo

evidence.note: Use the Varrock library to identify the smith at Mudskipper Point.

name: Give Thurgo a redberry pie if needed

evidence.note: Offer a pie to Thurgo if he has not accepted one before.

name: Ask Thurgo to repair the battleaxe

evidence.note: Give Thurgo the inlaid axe and iron bar after earning his help.

name: Deliver the clothing, boots and axe to Riki

evidence.note: Hand the three pieces to Riki, then speak to Blasidar.

name: Tell Veldaban the statue work is ready

evidence.note: Veldaban asks for company support for the statue’s head.

name: Complete the Blue Opal secretary’s ore orders

evidence.note: Accept ore requests that match the carried iron. The planned stock covers five orders of up to five ores each.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The secretary refers the player to the director.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Decline unsuitable jobs before accepting. Finish the secretary’s orders until referred.

name: Complete the director’s bar orders

evidence.note: Accept the director’s iron bar requests. The planned stock covers up to three orders of five bars.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The director accepts the player into the company.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Decline unsuitable requests before accepting and finish the requested orders.

name: Join the Blue Opal company and pledge support

evidence.note: Confirm membership and pledge support for the statue discussion.

name: Attend the Consortium meeting with Veldaban

evidence.note: Attend the meeting and receive the six skill rewards and two quest points.

name: Buy a rake and seed dibber for Kelda hops

evidence.note: Reserve for the two reusable farming tools.

name: Buy Kelda brewing ingredients

evidence.note: Buy the two filled buckets, two malt and the empty glass. This visit can fit into the growth wait.

name: Buy beer and a kebab in East Keldagrim

evidence.note: Make a short trip to the pub and kebab seller. The fixed reserve allows for the shop prices.

name: Buy two low-cost items for the Rowdy Dwarf

evidence.note: Carry two known request options. The player can request a different item if neither matches.

name: Take a stout near Khorvak

evidence.note: Take the stout available in the tunnel pub.

name: Take a pot in the brewing room

evidence.note: Use the pot on the brewing room table if needed.

name: Ask Veldaban about the Red Axe

evidence.note: Start after The Giant Dwarf and Fishing Contest.

name: Give the Drunken Dwarf a beer and get a seed

evidence.note: Bring him a beer and ask about his story.

name: Give the Rowdy Dwarf a cabbage

evidence.note: Wait for the corresponding request before handing over the item.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The Rowdy Dwarf gives his Kelda seed.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Ask for a different request after the dialogue allows it if needed.

name: Give the Rowdy Dwarf a potato

evidence.note: Wait for the corresponding request before handing over the item.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The Rowdy Dwarf gives his Kelda seed.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Ask for a different request after the dialogue allows it if needed.

name: Give Khorvak a Dwarven stout for a seed

evidence.note: Travel to the White Wolf Mountain tunnel and obtain Khorvak’s seed.

name: Share a beer with Gauss for a seed

evidence.note: Give Gauss a beer at the west pub.

name: Prepare the patch and plant four Kelda seeds

evidence.note: Ask Rind for permission, clear the patch and plant four seeds. Other work can proceed during the growth wait.

name: Harvest the grown Kelda hops

evidence.note: Return when the growth timer is ready.

name: Buy ale yeast from Blandebir

evidence.note: Bring an empty pot and 25 coins.

name: Load the vat and start fermenting Kelda stout

evidence.note: Add the water, malt, hops and yeast. The fermentation runs while the player completes other actions.

name: Turn the valve and fill a glass of Kelda stout

evidence.note: Check that the brew is ready before drawing it.

name: Give the Drunken Dwarf Kelda stout

evidence.note: Give him the stout and finish the story dialogue.

name: Ask the conductor about the sealed route

evidence.note: Learn whose authority is needed before using the secret cart.

name: Ask the Blue Opal director to open the route

evidence.note: Ask the director of the player’s company for permission.

name: Take the secret cart to the junction

evidence.note: Use the reopened cart with hands free.

name: Solve the first junction and investigate

evidence.note: Find the stones, operate the junction controls and use the first cart to hear the conversation.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The first Red Axe conversation has been heard.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Check the directional signs and use the cart after setting the route.

name: Solve the next route and search the records

evidence.note: Adjust the junction for the next cart and inspect the records.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The relevant records have been examined.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Use the control panel and the appropriate track.

name: Follow the last route and watch the Red Axe scene

evidence.note: Finish the final junction and return to the public cart after the scene.

name: Report the investigation to Veldaban

evidence.note: Complete the dialogue at the Black Guard headquarters.

name: Eat a kebab and drink a beer at the east pub

evidence.note: Finish the memory scene and receive Farming XP, Cooking XP and two mature Dwarven stouts.

name: Buy four gold bars for Dondakan

evidence.note: The demonstration bar is reused in the cannonball. Three bars are for the helmet.

name: Speak to Dondakan about the rock

evidence.note: Start after Dwarf Cannon and Fishing Contest.

name: Ask the Dwarven Engineer about the rock

evidence.note: Find the engineer in Keldagrim and learn about Rolad.

name: Ask Rolad about the book pages

evidence.note: Find Rolad at the Ice Mountain entrance to the Dwarven Mine.

name: Recover the three pages of Dwarven lore

evidence.note: Search a minecart, mine a suitable rock and defeat a scorpion to recover the pages.

planned_outcome.success_condition: All three pages have been recovered.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Continue the mining or combat steps until the relevant page appears.

name: Give Rolad the pages and read Dwarven lore

evidence.note: Have Rolad reassemble the book and read it.

name: Show Dondakan the book and a gold bar

evidence.note: Show how gold can affect the rock, then keep one bar for the cannonball.

name: Cast a gold cannonball at the furnace

evidence.note: Use the gold bar with an ammo mould at a furnace.

name: Give Dondakan the gold cannonball to test

evidence.note: Hand over the cannonball. Receive the base and Dondakan’s schematic information.

name: Get the engineer’s schematic section

evidence.note: Ask the Dwarven Engineer for their contribution.

name: Find the schematic section in Dwarven lore

evidence.note: Read the book to find its drawing before seeking the final piece.

name: Get Khorvak’s schematic section

evidence.note: Speak to Khorvak under White Wolf Mountain and finish the schematic conversation.

name: Overlay the schematic sections

evidence.note: Fit the schematic sections together.

name: Smith the gold helmet at the Keldagrim anvil

evidence.note: Use three gold bars and a hammer at the anvil.

name: Wear the helmet and let Dondakan fire the cannon

evidence.note: Give Dondakan the schematic and enter the rock with the helmet equipped.

name: Mine six gold ores inside the rock

evidence.note: Mine six ores while keeping the gold helmet equipped. Mining extra ore can weaken the Avatar.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Six or more ores are held before the encounter.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Keep the helmet equipped and mine more ore if time allows.

name: Defeat the Avatar while carrying the mined ore

evidence.note: Enter the inner rock, keep the helmet and six ores, and defeat the Avatar before returning to Dondakan.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The Avatar is defeated and the player is outside the rock.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring suitable combat gear and food. Mining more ore can reduce the Avatar’s combat level.

name: Report the victory to Dondakan

evidence.note: Receive 5,000 each in Defence, Mining and Smithing, two quest points and a rune pickaxe.

name: Buy a rope for the Lumbridge Swamp Caves

evidence.note: Reserve one rope for the surface cave entrance.

name: Speak to Ur-tag about the railway

evidence.note: Start after Death to the Dorgeshuun, The Giant Dwarf and The Dig Site.

name: Ask Tegdak for the excavation tools

evidence.note: Speak to Tegdak inside the railway works. Take a trowel and brush.

name: Excavate all six artefacts

evidence.note: Use the trowel at the six railway excavation points.

planned_outcome.success_condition: All six artefacts have been collected.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Check the excavation points along the unfinished track.

name: Clean the artefacts and show Tegdak

evidence.note: Use the brush at the table, show Tegdak the six pieces and ask Zanik to follow.

name: Ask the scribe about the artefacts

evidence.note: Bring Zanik to the scribe and discuss the mace.

name: Use Oldak’s sphere with Zanik to reach Goblin Village

evidence.note: Oldak supplies the quest transport so Zanik arrives with the player.

name: Speak to the Goblin Generals

evidence.note: Talk to Wartface and Bentnoze before responding to the attack.

name: Defeat the H.A.M. mage and archer

evidence.note: Use Ranged or Magic against the two attackers from their accessible position.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The attack is stopped.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring enough ammunition or runes for both enemies.

name: Speak to the generals after the attack

evidence.note: Finish the dialogue and take the ancient mace for the rescue.

name: Meet the goblin sergeants in Lumbridge Swamp

evidence.note: Bring the ancient mace and a light source for the caves.

name: Secure the rope and descend into the swamp caves

evidence.note: Use the rope at the cave entrance and follow the sergeants to the H.A.M. base.

name: Guide the sergeants past the H.A.M. patrols

evidence.note: Use the crates for cover, wait for the patrols, and use the ladder to reach Sigmund.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The sergeants have passed the guards and Sigmund is reachable.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Wait for the patrols and follow the sergeants’ timing.

name: Use the ancient mace special attack and defeat Sigmund

evidence.note: Use the mace’s special attack when Sigmund uses his protection prayer, then finish the fight.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Sigmund’s protection is removed and he is defeated.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Arrive with enough special attack energy and supplies to finish the fight.

name: Untie Zanik and watch the railway opening

evidence.note: Free Zanik and watch the opening scene. Receive Mining and Prayer XP and keep the ancient mace.
